messages:
emma-peopleops: Quick update — PDX hub: we just got a safety flag from facilities for a roof repair that starts immediately. Building management has asked us to close the hub at 1:30pm PT today. Please head home or work remotely after 1:30. :umbrella:
harry-pdx: whoa ok. Im still on site, laptop at desk. Can I stay until 4pm to finish a release?
emma-peopleops: Sorry, Harry — facilities said no non-essential staff after 1:30 while they do the inspection/repair. If you need hardware access DM me and well arrange a safe window.
mike-eng: If I drove and left my car at the lot, is parking covered if I need to get a rideshare later?
emma-peopleops: Yes — parking + rideshare covered. Use expense code PDX-STORM and attach a receipt. If you take a company rideshare well post a confirmation to the ticket.
sophia-facilities: Confirming: roof contractors are on site, safety perimeter enforced. No access to the rooftop or the north-side entrance until cleared. ETA ~3–5 hours but well update.
taylor-travel: For anyone stranded or with transit gaps, we arranged on-demand rides until 6pm PT via our TravelOps partner. To request, DM @taylor-travel with your name and pickup address or email travel-ops@redwood.com.
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — INC-2026-345 | PDX hub early closure (roof repair). Owner: facilities. Priority: medium.
emma-peopleops: For reimbursements, please submit via Concur with the following note and receipts:```
Expense code: PDX-STORM
Attach: parking receipt or rideshare invoice
Policy: emergency hub closure travel assistance
```
harry-pdx: Thanks — submitted photos of building notice and my parking receipt.
mike-eng: I grabbed a Lyft home, invoice attached. tagged expense PDX-STORM.
emma-peopleops: Got it — processing. If your team had scheduled interviews or onsite meetings this afternoon, please move them to virtual or reschedule. We updated the Hub calendar and Slack status to "PDX: closed until cleared".
sophia-facilities: Safety team will post another update here once the perimeter is removed. If anyone needs to pick up hardware, we'll coordinate a 15-minute escorted pickup after sign-off.
ops-bot: UPDATE INC-2026-345 | Safety inspection in progress. Next update in ~30m.
emma-peopleops: Small ops note for managers: please allow flexible check-outs and approve emergency travel expenses quickly. If you need headcount for rideshare, DM me. :heart:
mike-eng: Appreciate the quick coordination, folks.
harry-pdx: stay safe everyone. :thumbsup:
emma-peopleops: Closing thread — Ill post a final update when facilities signs off or by 5:30pm PT whichever comes first.
